description: Item 3 of PR #1650: test whether PR #1645's sign-block/Plancherel template transfers to Q_β c_3 = -2 = J_Hopf(q=1). Complement to sibling Q_β Habiro work; non-competing categorical-template check.

data.verdict: NON-PLANCHEREL EXACT MATCHES: ['(g) 2·σ_1(sign)|_{q=1} = -2', '(j) -(q²+q⁻²) at q=1 (Jones-Hopf)']. c_3 = -2 is reproducible as -[2]_q at q=1, but NOT directly as a Plancherel-weighted sum at H_2. The sign-block template does NOT directly transfer; c_3 is the Hopf-link Jones evaluation, NOT a Plancherel-channel projection. Complements sibling Q_β Habiro work (independent categorical mechanism).
